chapterPurpose: ‘The Frog’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects frog life and habitat, movement and adaptation, water and land environments, observation of animal features, descriptive language. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
